prompt:
Generate a commercial product mockup image for the Brazilian real estate campaign execution kit Imobiturbo. Use the attached image ONLY as a reference for the tangible bundle COMPOSITION: an upright central product, open material pages behind it, a smartphone at left, a tablet at right, and a collection of smaller materials in the foreground. Replace every religious subject and every color, label, illustration and item with the real estate materials described here. The result is a standalone product image, not a landing page screenshot.
Scene: photographic studio packshot of a digital material collection. Seamless exact solid background #09090B. Camera at eye level with slight three-quarter perspective, complete uncut objects, soft side lighting with subtle believable shadows. Objects occupy almost all the canvas, leave just 5% margin.
Subject: central upright black folio box and thick spiral-bound operating workbook, surrounded by open printed white pages, a laptop partly visible at rear, a smartphone and a tablet, then smaller booklets at the base. Matte black covers, white paper, restrained neon lime #c5fe6d and sage green #69a438. Contemporary typography in the visual style of Plus Jakarta Sans, aligned typography, generous paper margins. Beautiful Brazilian contemporary house photography appears on the campaign templates on the devices and on one workbook cover. Specific editorial real estate content, avoid generic placeholder loading bars.
Important details: central largest cover EXACT TEXT in Brazilian Portuguese: "SuperCombo", "Black Friday", "Imobiliária", "2026". Secondary label "Imobiturbo" small and discreet. A visible open page headed "SPIN Selling" contains sections "Situação", "Problema", "Implicação", "Necessidade" with real short question lines and space to fill. Another loose page headed "Matriz de Oferta" shows a table of condition, deadline, benefit, authorization with blank form fields. The laptop shows "Calculadora de meta e verba" as a spreadsheet. A spiral planner at left titled "Operação 45 Dias" shows a real campaign calendar. A white smartphone displays a genuine-looking vertical campaign art of a house with the words "Black Friday Imobiliária" and "27 de novembro". The right tablet shows "Kit de Criativos" with four house ad thumbnails. Along the base, four small black/green booklets, clearly labeled "Lista VIP", "Follow-up de 7 dias", "Ganchos e copies", "Últimas Horas". Booklets have useful house imagery or fine diagrams, substantial objects with spines and visible pages.
Use case: the image will be placed on a dark landing page to show exactly the types of materials received in a low-ticket real estate preparation bundle. It is an illustrative mockup. The physical forms represent digital materials, not physical shipping.
Constraints: all visible text rendered in Brazilian Portuguese. Keep the typography clean and the specified major titles spelled correctly. Only the requested kit and materials. No award badges, gold seals, best-seller labels, discounts, prices, testimonials, unverifiable numbers or certification claims. No floating decorative neon lines, no skeletal text placeholder bars, no stock app icons. Build a cohesive bundle that reads as useful pages and templates at thumbnail size. Landscape 1536x1024, final quality high.

Generate the image with aspect ratio 3:2 (landscape).
